title: v3.0.0: Share Cards, Hindi App & Worship Tools
body: The biggest Vandana update yet. Share any song section or the daily verse as a beautiful image — made for WhatsApp. Switch the whole app to Hindi (हिंदी) from Settings, or let the new Auto theme follow your phone's light or dark mode. Browse faster with the A–Z letter strip, reorder songs within a setlist, and during worship blank the Present Mode screen for prayer or swipe between setlist songs. Spotted a wrong lyric? Report it right from the song page. Installed app icons now open straight to Setlist, Favourites, or the Library.

title: Zindagi Ka Badshah Aane Wala Hai Added
body: Added Zindagi Ka Badshah Aane Wala Hai by Yeshu Bhakti Geet Official with reviewed Hindi and Hinglish lyrics about staying ready for Yeshu's return.

title: Safer Pages & Cleaner Song Review
body: Improved page metadata safety and added stricter behind-the-scenes lyric review tools, so future song imports can be checked, cleaned, and sectioned more consistently before they reach the app.

body: Added and refreshed key Bridge Music songs with clean Hindi and Hinglish lyrics, including Gawahi, Haath Uthaakar Gaoonga, Dhanyawad, Sang Tere, Teri Marzi, Desh, Aadi Aur Anth, and Papa.

body: Added Bhala Pita and Panah, merged the duplicate Haan Hai Yakeen entry, and replaced noisy scraped lyrics for Shaktishaali and Hazaaron Zubane with clean Hindi and Hinglish sections.

The importer repairs this source's Hindi encoding, collapses duplicate files, and keeps already-curated songs from being overwritten. The library now has 2,908 songs.

title: 405 More Worship Songs Added
body: Added 405 more worship songs after a deeper review of all three scraped lyric batches. Clean songs are now allowed even when the source does not name an artist, while duplicate songs, short files, page junk, placeholder lyrics, and regional-language sources needing manual review stay out. The library now has 910 songs.

title: 11 Reviewed Worship Songs Added
body: Added 11 carefully reviewed worship songs from the latest library batches and refreshed 4 existing songs with cleaner credits or lyrics. The library now has 505 songs, while noisier scraped files stay out of the app until they are manually cleaned.

title: 162 More Worship Songs Added
body: Added the first clean wave from the new lyrics batch: 162 new songs and 7 refreshed songs. The larger scraped folder was screened for duplicates, noisy titles, unsupported regional-language entries, and short files before anything was added. The library now has 494 songs.

title: 65 More Worship Songs Added
body: Added 65 new Hindi/Hinglish worship songs and refreshed 25 existing songs with cleaner lyrics, better artist credits where verified, and fuller language coverage. The library now has 332 songs available through search, setlists, favourites, and Present Mode.

title: v2.1.0: Settings, Font Size & Polish
body: You can now set your preferred lyrics font size directly in Settings, so every song opens at the size you like. Loading screens now match each page's real layout for a smoother experience. The About section also now credits Isus Christos Ministries (ICM), whose blessing made this app possible.

title: Setlists, Better Search & Smoother Navigation
body: Added setlists for worship planning, next and previous controls in Present Mode, lyrics-aware search with fuzzy matching, clearer empty states, visible favourite and setlist buttons, smoother tab switching, offline/update notices, and a more balanced floating navigation bar.

title: Bug Fixes & Long-Press to Favourite
body: Hold any song on the home screen to instantly save it to favourites, no need to open the song. Also fixed skeleton loading screens, corrected swipe behaviour on recently viewed, and songs now appear in Recently Viewed after you visit them.

title: Missing Artists Recovered
body: Added accurate artist and church information mapping to 189 existing songs in the database. You can now properly browse and search these songs by their artists.

title: Improved Hindi Lyrics
body: All Hindi song lyrics have been re-transliterated for better accuracy. Fixed edge cases in transliteration so the text reads more naturally.

title: Refreshed Icons & Visuals
body: All icons across the app have been upgraded to a cleaner, more consistent design. The Vandana wordmark has also been improved.

title: Mobile Layout Fixes
body: Fixed church filter overflow, search icon alignment, and empty state sizing on smaller screens for a smoother mobile experience.

title: New Feature: Favourites
body: You can now save your favourite songs and access them instantly.

title: 100 Songs Added
body: We've added 100 new worship songs from ICM, Nations of Worship, Sheldon Bangera and more.
